verdict.rationale: Browserbase is an API platform, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question to ask. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404, and no documentation mentions a published spec. The llms.txt file and the Node.js SDK reference are adjacent resources, not a machine-readable API specification, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
